proposal.reason: Main change is in P2P transport IPC registration: it now registers/maps full multi-segment physical ranges (with MULTI_SEGMENT_REGISTER), tracks segment metadata, and updates proxy register/deregister flows for segment-aware imports. Add memory for substantive allocation/mapping ownership changes (segment-aware ncclHgMemFree/ncclHgMemFreeAddr and deregistration callback ordering to prevent stale reused-address mappings). Add network for independently substantive proxy/UDS FD-transfer lifecycle changes (batch FD query, per-connection imported-handle tracking, and cleanup on partial-transfer/error paths).
